verdict.rationale: MoonPay publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages (quotes, sessions) built on an OpenAPI 3.1 spec. It also offers a test mode and clone-able demo integrations with working examples, but nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or lets you run requests in-page. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at standard public paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser 'try it' console or playground, runnable request examples embedded in the reference, a publicly fetchable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
